heroHeadline: Attack on Saudi Tanker Sidr Puts Untested Mecca Pact to Its First Major Test
heroSubtitle: Tracking signatories, accession candidates, treaty terms, and regional reactions — as a strike on a Saudi-flagged tanker in the Strait of Hormuz raises the first real question of whether Pakistan or Turkey will invoke the pact's mutual-defense clause, with neither yet responding.
